back_cover_blurb: Describe it. Build it. Ship it.
Vibe coding means building software by describing what you want in plain English and letting an AI write the code. This book teaches you to do it well, with Claude Code.

You will build seven real, tested apps, from a tip calculator to a mobile app and QuickBite, a production-quality food delivery app with Razorpay and Stripe payments. Every prompt and reply in those chapters comes from a real session. No programming background required.
- Prompt patterns, testing, debugging, and Git
- UI and UX design that works for everyone
- AI-powered apps, and Android and iPhone apps
- Choosing the right Claude model for accurate code
- Supabase, Firebase, Razorpay, and Stripe, end to end
- Launching on web.app, Google Play, and the App Store
- CLAUDE.md, skills, subagents, hooks, and MCP
- The software lifecycle, security, and best practices
